'''Organ Grinder''' is a monthly duel event that facilitates grudge matches between pairs of players. Players will sign up with their opponent, select a game, select maps, and then play a single {{Abbr|BO3|Best of 3}} during the show.

It is a multi-game show, featuring games like Doom 2, '''Quakeworld''', Quake II, Quake Live, Quake 4, CPMA, Diabotical, Doombringer, Warfork, Quake Champions, and more!

===Prize pool===
The show collects donations into a prize pool. Winners of their duels will split 75% of the pool, losers will split 25%.

===Signups===
Signups are taken first-come-first-serve, regardless of skill level. Some curation may occur to support variety during the show. Signup periods last one week after the prior event, and matches will be selected the following week.

===Format===
* '''7 multi-game matchups''' 
** All matchups are {{Abbr|BO3|Best of 3}}
** Each player picks 1 map each, and add 2 more maps for potential decider
** Decider map is randomly selected out of 4 submitted maps

==Organ Harvester==
As the sister show, or companion piece to Organ Grinder, '''[[Organ Harvester]]''' has the same function as a fighting sport weigh-in with review of the previous Organ Grinder event.
